# Browser Dependencies

## ExcelJS 4.4.0

- Purpose: generate real XLSX task reports in the browser, loaded only when exporting Excel.
- Upstream: https://github.com/exceljs/exceljs/tree/v4.4.0
- Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/exceljs@4.4.0/dist/exceljs.min.js
- License: MIT, retained in `exceljs.LICENSE`.
- No task data is sent to a third-party service. The bundle is served locally.
- SHA-256 (`exceljs-4.4.0.min.js`): `7e49da68588e250dbb8bba190d2caa8ab3787cc0284bda1d8b2f805c4df742c9`.
